rules: Freeze truth/evaluation rules before inspecting either caller outcome
Preserve unresolved/not-assessed entries and exclusions; do not force them to negatives
For conditional sensitivity require independently supported eligible positive truth; negative truth is not mathematically required for that narrow target
For precision independently adjudicate positive calls with documented sampling/ascertainment; a full negative universe is not interchangeable with sampled call adjudication
For specificity/FPR define and independently assess the eligible negative frame; a list of absent VCF records is insufficient
Report performance only for the admitted truth/frame and maintain dependence-aware uncertainty; more loci do not automatically add independent biological units
Native origin needs a separate event/ancestry identity; do not relabel the genotype key as an origin identifier

replay_fields_to_preserve: source object digest and row index
sample plus CHROM:POS_REF/ALT key and duplicate/multiallelic state
metadata and figure labels, predecessor, training flags
reference VAF/call state, target QC and missing values
original and derived FILTER, exact header cutoff, comparison type semantics
final caller label with order of overrides
literal global eligibility and separately named sample-specific eligibility
category numerator, sample denominator, zero-denominator state and category-contributing sample count
reopen_when: A target-specific independently supported truth/evaluation resource and its provenance are concretely identified
The selected complete input scope is licensed, identity-resolved and fits a declared acquisition/working budget
Model/reference/adaptation history and biological dependence structure support the proposed claim
